Name: Mini Pig Pet
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=4]Can be adopted at the start of a new save or at Marnie's after getting access to pet adoption.[/size]

[size=4]The main 3 Mini Pig has a small chance to give 1-2 truffles at max friendship.[/size]

[size=4]All of the Piggies have Configurable prices and the 6 added in 1.2.0 have unique gifts![/size]

[size=4]Unique Piggy Gifts:[/size]
[spoiler]Alien Pig: Radioactive Ore after entering Qi's walnut room (Crabs before).
Ghost Pig: Mastery related items after they've been unlocked (Iridium bars before).
Golden Pig: Money.
Iridium Pig: Iridium Ore.
Opossum Pig(aka Opig): Bone Fragments and Bone Artifacts.
Trader/Traveling Pig: Mostly Furniture but small chance for Rare Seed or Fez Hat.[/spoiler]

Downloads.Description: Added 6 more adoptable piggies.(only adoptable from Marnie)
